svg.title: Attendance support and approved daily time
svg.desc: Attendance support and approved daily time. Which stored keys connect a daily time record to its supporting evidence? Primary tables: ShiftDefinition, EmployeeShiftAssignment, EmployeeShiftRoster, EmployeeAbsence, OvertimeApproval, TimeClockPunch, TimeClockEntry, AttendanceException. There is no assignment ID on the roster or punch ID on AttendanceException. Effective-date matching and shared roster/time records supply those investigations; a flag does not prove a payment block.
